method:
Independent read-only audit of the optional Cream depth refinement.

Decode native ROM 4bpp pixels, BG quarter flips/palettes and animation payloads
without importing the asset builder. The approved exception is Cream paintings,
the Cream-only return doorway, and appended Cream environment metatiles. Existing
IDs, physical metadata, other regions, Bloom, HUD and original music are exact.
This static audit does not establish artistic quality or replace real mGBA drops.

checks.name: frozen build option agrees with header
audited art/runtime matches pinned source commit
forest map entries address resident tiles/palettes
sewer map entries address resident tiles/palettes
myst map entries address resident tiles/palettes
cream map entries address resident tiles/palettes
original PCM section and loop continuations
complete Cream source IDs match native ROM

detail.gate_states: all physically closed and all physically opened
detail.scope: Host actual pinned C generators; renderer stubbed; real mGBA proof separate

limits: Read-only ROM/source audit. It does not certify artistic quality, actual landing visibility, runtime coordinate correspondence, room composition or collision agreement in play; those require the separate geometry and real mGBA reviews.
